preamble: The Middle Chinese 船 (chuán) initial [dʑ] became Mandarin [ʂ] in most syllables (aspirated [ʈʂʰ] in some level-tone words, cf. 船 chuán).
sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
